# Igris 2.0.2

This fixes chat requests that reported saved tasks or reminders without creating database records. Greetings, plural tasks and the common “remainder” spelling now use verified Core actions. “Tomorrow” uses the current Asia/Kolkata day; a list of tasks is saved as separate items. Date-only tasks do not silently create timed reminders. Find scheduled reminders in **Tasks → reminders**.

- Project setup asks for the name, description and public frontend/backend/health URLs in chat. Say “skip monitoring” for a project without URLs. Labelled details take precedence over list/briefing keywords. Configured projects and their monitoring entries save together.
- Initial endpoint checks report actual HTTP/network errors. Health JSON can report unhealthy components even with HTTP 200. Projects and daily briefings show component status, errors, latency and freshness, grouped across projects.
- Notes have a shared rich text editor on Windows and Android: headings, bold, italic, underline, colors, fonts, bullets, automatic numbering and undo/redo. Chat note commands support Markdown and spoken formatting, saved as the same structured document.
- Multi-task saves are atomic and retry-safe. Referenced tasks, splitting a previously combined task and locating recently saved items use workspace records rather than a model's success claim. Manual controls remain available.
- Native window controls, protected provider storage, image discovery, read-only Wellvell access, economy budgets and provider cooldowns remain available.

Quit Igris from the tray before installing. Keep the same Firebase account and trusted-device pairing. Core defaults to https://igris-core.onrender.com; saved Connection settings take precedence.

Locally verified: 64 browser tests and 50 Core tests, including real isolated PostgreSQL. Android publication requires the original release.jks signing credentials. Background notifications and daily briefing generation require the production scheduler to target Render; Cloudflare authentication and real closed-app delivery remain pending. Attachments remain session-local.
